# Mandar Vyas — Portfolio

> Portfolio of Mandar Vyas, Senior Mobile Engineer: React Native at scale (Dream11, Superhealth), web interaction labs, and in-phone case studies.

This site is a client-rendered React application. The home page is an interactive iPhone-style portfolio: lock screen, Experience and Projects on the home screen, in-phone About Me and Open Source hubs, Settings (themes), and dock shortcuts (Mail, LinkedIn, GitHub).

Canonical site: https://mandarvyas.vercel.app

## Site

- [Home](https://mandarvyas.vercel.app/): Interactive phone shell — experience, projects, About Me, open source
- [Work](https://mandarvyas.vercel.app/work): Project gallery and case studies (`/work/:projectId`)

## Case studies

- [Animate Spotlight Showcase](https://mandarvyas.vercel.app/work/animate-spotlight-showcase): Motion and spotlight interaction lab
- [Transition Trail Explorer](https://mandarvyas.vercel.app/work/transition-trail-explorer): UI transition and trail exploration
- [MovieBuzz](https://mandarvyas.vercel.app/work/moviebuzz): React Native movie discovery app
- [Sudoku](https://mandarvyas.vercel.app/work/sudoku): Create-and-solve Sudoku (React Native)
- [Deep Link Doctor](https://mandarvyas.vercel.app/work/deep-link-doctor): Deep-link debugging tool

## For agents

- [Agent Resource Descriptor](https://mandarvyas.vercel.app/.well-known/ard.json): Machine-readable site metadata (AIR)
- [Sitemap](https://mandarvyas.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Crawlable routes
